text: AI is changing the workplace in many ways. Automation now handles repetitive tasks, such as organizing data or answering simple customer questions. Productivity tools powered by AI help employees work faster by suggesting emails, scheduling meetings, and analyzing information. Many companies are also exploring human-AI collaboration, where people and machines work together to solve problems. This can lead to better results, because AI is good at processing data while humans bring creativity and judgment. However, these changes also affect jobs. Some roles may disappear, while new ones will appear, so workers need to learn new skills. Overall, AI offers both opportunities and challenges for everyone at work.
